Name: Eemie's Just A New Map Recolour - Content Patcher Edition
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Eemie's lovely palette changes converted to Content Patcher
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

I've always loved Eemie's Map Recolor and wished there was a way to make it cross compatible with other map tweaks.  The solution?  Make it a Content Patcher pack!  With Eemie's permission, all the versions of her map recolor have been compiled into one pack, along with compatibility files for the ladder used in Expanded Maps (and similar mods).  Also included with permission are Ali's Flower Grasses; you may choose which grass you want via a config file.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work and should work with any custom maps you may have (however, please let me know if you find it does not).

NOTE: When updating to 1.4.0+, please delete your config file and allow it to regenerate, as one of the fields has been removed.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Eemie's Map Recolors' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once using SMAPI to generate the config file.

5.  Access the config file from the mod folder and choose your settings.  Options will be listed below, as well as in the readme.
Config Options

*   SpringColor - choose between "Pink" and "Green"; defaults to "Pink"

*   FallColor - choose between "Green" and "Orange"; defaults to "Green"

*   DirtColor - choose between "Classic" and "Light"; defaults to "Classic"

*   UseFallBushes - choose between orange and green fall bushes; uses True/False.  Defaults to "true"

*   UseEemiePine - toggle Eemie's birch/pine tree on and off with True/False.  Defaults to "true"

*   AliGrass - allows choices between each of Ali's five grass variants and Eemie's grass or disable it completely to use a different grass altogether.  Defaults to "AliEemie".  Variants as follows:

1.  "Eemie"

2.  "AliEemie"

3.  "Normal"

4.  "Alternate"

5.  "Vibrant"

6.  "AlternateVibrant"

7.  "disable"

*   UseWorldMapRecolor - choose if you want to use Zander's world map recolor with True/False.  Defaults to "true".  If you use Bouhm's [NPC Map Locations](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239)﻿, a recolored map is included with that mod and will activate automatically upon installing this

*   Petbowl - allows you to toggle different pet bowl variants for custom farm maps.  Choose between Vanilla, Void, Dirt, Grass, and Darkgrass; defaults to Vanilla
